title: Rutan Voyager takes off for round the world trip, with Dick Rutan and Jeana Yeager - 14 Dec 1986
description:
‪[video by Edwards AFB]


#‎OTD‬ 14 Dec 1986 at Edwards - The Voyager, an ultra-long-range special-purpose aircraft piloted by Dick Rutan and Jeana Yeager, began its journey on an attempt to fly around the world without landing or refueling. The aircraft, which was heavily loaded with fuel, used more than 14,000 ft of the 15,000-ft main runway before it lifted into the air.
